End-to-end encrypted vaults keep their passwords and keys encrypted with keys that only your devices have: the server, its operator or a stolen backup cannot read them. Set up your key once; then turn it on per vault (vault settings → Encryption).
Only secrets are end-to-end encrypted: names, addresses, users and notes stay readable by the server so search and server features keep working.
